collectionPolicy.startBoundary: No pre-acceptance observation may enter the prospective outcome sample
collectionPolicy.sourceFailurePolicy: Fail closed; required source missing, stale, malformed, or incoherent means no ENTRER; never impute
collectionPolicy.privateCredentials: Never store API tokens, cookies, or credentials in this repository

allowedSources.limitations: Use only closed, complete candles; collector must persist exact request parameters and raw response hash

purpose: support-break context when independently defined and timestamped
allowedSources.limitations: If BTC return or confirmed support status is unavailable, veto entry

purpose: secondary price and spot liquidity/cross-venue coherence check
allowedSources.limitations: Secondary descriptive check only; missing, stale, or incoherent data veto ENTRER
Fundamentals are context only; token unlocks and notable flows remain UNAVAILABLE unless independently verified
News headlines are not a standalone entry trigger

allowedSources.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
purpose: macro context: DFF, DGS10, DTWEXBGS, CPIAUCSL, and declared extended series
allowedSources.limitations: Use observation dates as event times and fetch times as availability times; macro source age limit is seven days
Calendar parser schema marker failure means UNAVAILABLE; no guessed event dates
Sentiment is noisy context, not a predictive claim
Manipulable descriptive context only; parser/provider failure means UNAVAILABLE

purpose: optional social context when credentials are configured outside the repository
allowedSources.limitations: Optional; never commit X_BEARER_TOKEN; absent credentials or request failure means UNAVAILABLE

purpose: funding rate provenance only, if endpoint response passes existing schema and freshness checks
allowedSources.limitations: Not an entry trigger; no inference about spot liquidity or edge

blockedOrUnavailableSources.reason: Smoke test has not yet confirmed root cause; diagnostic may reveal transport timeout, schema/envelope mismatch, symbol mismatch, or stale/invalid fields
blockedOrUnavailableSources.policy: Do not use, substitute, estimate, or impute open interest; keep terminal status UNAVAILABLE until manual diagnostic evidence and independent review

blockedOrUnavailableSources.reason: No public API endpoint for authoritative TEL supply/unlocks was identified in the current repository; do not invent or infer one
blockedOrUnavailableSources.policy: Official public repositories/releases may be reviewed manually, but are not machine-authorized inputs until a concrete endpoint, schema, timestamp semantics, and provenance policy are separately reviewed and added

blockedOrUnavailableSources.reason: Current provider contract does not supply independently verified token unlock schedule or notable flow data
blockedOrUnavailableSources.policy: Required supply angle remains fail-closed; no ENTRER while this mandatory angle is UNAVAILABLE

prohibitedSourcesAndPractices: Phase 3 frozen BTCUSDT dataset or any Phase 3 holdout observation
Pre-acceptance journal entries as prospective outcome samples
Backfilled or revised values represented as available at the original decision time
Unversioned third-party whale signals or generic on-chain metrics as entry triggers
Undocumented endpoint substitutions, silent imputations, or source failures hidden as valid values
API credentials, personal position data, average entry price, or private user notes in public repository files
